source_summary: Vertical ink landscape with layered pale mountains, dark dotted tree groves, small buildings nestled in cliffs, a waterfall/stream descending through rocks, riverbank huts, foreground terraces, a tiny scholar figure, and reeds/boat forms; calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_left_misty_summits
motifs.description: Isolate the tall pale mountain mass in the upper left, including the rounded summit outlines, soft vertical washes, faint inner texture strokes, and the dark clustered tree crowns along the top ridge and right shoulder.
must_preserve: faint vertical texture strokes on cliff faces
dark dotted foliage on summit ridge

motifs.name: central_spires_and_pine_groves
motifs.description: Isolate the central cluster of rocky spires and dense pine/brush groves below the high peaks, including pale stone forms, layered cliff planes, and the dark needle-like foliage masses scattered across the ridges.
must_preserve: layered ridge separation in light wash

motifs.name: right_sheer_cliff_wall
motifs.description: Isolate the narrow sheer cliff formation on the right side of the mountain group, with its tall vertical pale rock face, darker base wash, and sparse trees clinging to the inner left edge.
must_preserve: transparent grey wash down the rock face
small foliage clusters along the inner ridge
soft mist transition at the bottom

motifs.name: left_hillside_pavilion_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the left-middle hillside with the small roofed pavilion tucked among trees, including surrounding trunks, dense leaf dots, rocky slope, and the slanted roofline partly hidden by foliage.
must_preserve: fine architectural linework visible through trees
rough hillside wash and rock texture

motifs.name: cliffside_house_and_waterfall
motifs.description: Isolate the central cliffside building complex with its tiled roof, rectangular walls, adjacent trees, narrow rock ledge, and the waterfall/stream dropping beneath it through the cleft.
must_preserve: stepped rock ledges and dry-brush cliff texture

motifs.name: lower_left_foreground_terrace
motifs.description: Isolate the broad lower-left foreground rock terrace and path area, excluding the tiny figure if possible, with heavy dark ink at the cliff base, pale sloping ground, and layered horizontal rock strokes.
must_preserve: dark saturated ink along cliff foot
irregular edge where terrace meets mist

motifs.name: lower_right_riverside_huts_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right riverside hamlet: small thatched huts and fenced forms set beside a dense grove, with fine roof outlines, dark foliage dots, and the pale open water/shore edge around them.
must_preserve: thatched roof outlines and small eaves
simple hut wall and fence linework
dense rounded shrub and tree stippling

motifs.name: tiny_scholar_under_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the small walking scholar figure at the lower left beneath the cliff, including the rounded head/hat, robe outline, and minimal ground strokes immediately supporting the figure.

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
